test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper offered a machine at a discount of 10% after setting its marked price at 10% above the cost price. His loss percentage is ____________.
solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 10%

Marked Price = 10% above Cost Price

**Concept Used:**

Selling Price = [(100 - Discount%)/100] × MP

Loss = CP - SP

Loss % = [Loss/CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the CP be Rs. 100.

Marked Price = 10% above Cost Price

Marked Price = Rs. 110

Discount = 10%

Selling Price = [(100 - Discount%)/100] × MP

Selling Price = [(100 - 10%)/100] × 110

⇒ [90/100] × 110

⇒ Rs. 99

Loss = CP - SP

⇒ 100 - 99 = Rs. 1

Loss % = [Loss/CP] × 100

⇒ [1/100] × 100

⇒ 1%

His loss percentage is 1%.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
